entities.name: Query kynureninase
observations: 499 aa protein; predicted molecular weight 54.9 kDa and pI 5.43.
Matches reviewed fungal kynureninases Q2U038, A1C688, and Q1DZA6 at 59.0–61.2% identity over 92.6–94.6% query coverage.
Contains Aminotran_5 domain (PF00266; residues 113–289) and KYNU_C domain (PF22580; residues 367–464).
Homology supports a pyridoxal-5'-phosphate-dependent kynureninase, likely cytosolic and dimeric; exact organism and substrate preference are not established by sequence alone.

entities.name: Q2U038 kynureninase
observations: Uses pyridoxal 5'-phosphate and cleaves L-kynurenine to anthranilate plus L-alanine.
Annotated to L-tryptophan catabolism and quinolinate/NAD+ biosynthesis; reported as a cytosolic homodimer.

entities.name: L-kynurenine cleavage
observations: Rhea-mapped reaction: L-kynurenine + H2O → anthranilate + L-alanine + H+.
This is the canonical kynureninase reaction associated with EC 3.7.1.3.

entities.name: 3-hydroxykynurenine cleavage
observations: This substrate/product pair is annotated for multiple close fungal kynureninases, but sequence alone does not establish relative substrate preference.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate
observations: PLP is the curated cofactor for the homologous kynureninases and is required for kynureninase catalytic activity.
